text:
sam: starting an A/B cascade for v4-alpha-int8 with per-slice decay policy. goal: avoid noisy global rollback by capping variant share per slice.
nina: tl;dr of stages?
sam: shadow 10% 90m, narrow-live 0.2% 60m, ramp 1% 60m, broad 5% 2h. hysteresis: 2 consecutive passing windows to advance; single fail halves traffic; two fails -> rollback.
derek: gate vector and thresholds?
sam: baseline prod=v3.9-pt. metrics: ROUGE-L_delta, exact_match_delta, halluc_rate_delta, latency_p95_delta, embed_sim_delta. pass = 4/5 within thresholds; slice_abort if any slice metric > 0.06.
product-amy: hallucination gets extra weight in tie-breaker, small halluc jumps are worse than minor rouge drops
sam: implemented: safety_penalty = 2*halluc_delta; final_score = mean(rouge,exact,embed_sim) - safety_penalty - latency_penalty. auto-fallback if final_score < -0.04 or slice > 0.06.
eval-bot: shadow run (90m) done. overall: rouge -0.007, exact -0.003, halluc +0.009, p95 +0.05, embed_sim -0.012
nina: any slices > abort?
eval-bot: api_readme longform: halluc +0.041 (40 samples), kb_exports short: embed_sim -0.065 (25 samples)
derek: api_readme breach. suspect int8 behavior on long sequences / kv-cache. run targeted shadow routing only api_readme with variants: pt-only, int8-only, mix 0.8/0.2, 0.6/0.4, 500 samples each.
eval-bot: targeted runs complete. pt-only halluc +0.003; int8-only +0.047; 0.8/0.2 +0.018; 0.6/0.4 +0.031
nina: int8 is the culprit for that slice.
derek: rather than global rollback, suggest per-slice variant cap and adaptive decay: per_slice_variant_cap default 0.2; on first breach halve the cap; floor at 0.05.
sam: routing supports per-slice weights. will apply int8 cap=0.05 for api_readme and re-run short shadow.
eval-bot: api_readme (int8=0.05) 30m shadow summary: halluc +0.006, embed_sim -0.015
nina: acceptable.
sam: updated canary config and will start narrow-live for longform only: per-slice int8 cap 0.2, adaptive decay policy in place. timeline: push staging tonight 0100 UTC, shadow tomorrow 0900 UTC, narrow-live after manual thumbs-up or auto when consensus met.
ops-sre: add hard p95 latency ceiling +0.2 relative -> immediate 0% cut and pager. emit promote_stall alert if stuck > 90m. also record per-variant kv_warmup_sec and per-slice sample_count.
derek: log example pairs where hallucation flagged so annotators can triage (redwood-evals queue).
product-amy: I'll notify api_readme owners to watch UX and pause promotion if they see regressions.
sam: notes: prefer adaptive per-slice caps for quantized variants; targeted shadows for problematic slices reduce noisy global rollbacks. will add explainer to canary notes.
eval-bot: narrow-live started -> two windows passed -> auto-increment to 1% -> later promoted to 5% with per-slice caps applied; transient p95 spike at T+2h resolved by autoscaler.
ops-sre: postmortem: spike was autoscaler lag, increased scale buffer for future ramps.
product-amy: thanks team! documented runbook changes and per-slice cap rationale.
derek: lesson captured: per-slice adaptive caps + targeted shadows prevent cascade failures and keep high-performing quant variants live where safe.
ops-sre: monitoring will continue overnight and escalate if anything pops.
